title: manifest.jsonl — NITI Aayog Annual Report
description: One NITI Aayog Annual Report acquisition record (REQ-0020 residual). The reports carry the 'Young Professionals' headcount, a named primary source for the contractualisation / consultant face of the outsourcing panel.

report_year.description: Fiscal year, read from the FILENAME. Never from the URL path: documents live under /sites/default/files/<YYYY-MM>/, which matches a fiscal-year pattern and invents years like 2020-02. The second half may be printed as two or four digits (2022-2023), which a two-digit tail silently turns into 2022-20.

language.description: Read from the filename, which marks it three different ways — `(English)`, `(Hindi)` with no space, and bare `Hindi_V3`. A parenthesis- or word-boundary-anchored match misses the third and mislabels a Hindi report as English.

text_layer.description: Whether the PDF reads back as text, so the Young Professionals table can be extracted without OCR. Null means extraction was not attempted or failed — never assume true.
